issue: RenPy testcase only expressions are evaluated during parse. Lint compiled the environment-dependent flag as false, so the supposed smoke command ran the full suite.
engine_evidence: RenPy 8.5.3 renpy/test/testparser.py evaluates property expressions with renpy.python.py_eval at parse time.
correction: Remove conditional only flags. Execute each of three explicitly named testcases in its own process, then execute the unchanged complete global suite.
